title: The realized compact-support scalar system map
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, $X,Y$ finite-type $K_0$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$, a compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $\iota:E\to L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $F_E,F_L$ for the fixed integral compact-support functors [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action], and $T^W_{L/E}$ for completed integral scalar extension on $W$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. For each $K\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ define the canonical underlying derived arrow
$$s^c_{L/E,K}:T^Y_{L/E}(F_EK)\longrightarrow F_L(T^X_{L/E}K).$$
Use the whole-system operation realization [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]: let $H_A=J_{j,A}P_{p,A}$ be strict open extension followed by strict proper direct image, let $e$ be its specified system coefficient mate, and let $\rho_A:F_A\simeq\operatorname{realize}(H_A)$ be the projection-normalized compact realization. Define $s^c_{L/E,K}$ as $T^Y_{L/E}(\rho_E(K))$, followed by the component at $K$ of $\operatorname{coefficientExchange}(H_E,H_L,e)$, followed by $\rho_L(T^X_{L/E}K)^{-1}$. All coefficients, quotient transitions, reduction counits and Roos-limit maps are those of the recorded whole-system construction. This defines an arrow; invertibility and scalar coherence are separate assertions. The residue-unit helper transports the given unit $\ell\in K_0^\times$ through global sections and each residue-field evaluation.

def sfCompactSupportScalarSystemMap
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    (integralScalarExtension l E L ι Y).obj
        ((sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l K₀ hl c E).obj K).obj ⟶
      ((sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l K₀ hl c L).obj
        ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
          (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι X).obj K)).obj
